title: 潘功胜：香港背靠中国内地政策稳定，人民币国际化带来开放机遇
speaker: Pan Gongsheng

segments.en: Hong Kong enjoys stability anchored by the mainland policy. Also enjoys the openness endorsed by the internationalization of RMB.
segments.zh: 香港享有内地政策带来的稳定，也受益于人民币国际化带来的开放。

segments.en: China as a central driver for the global economy, China's mainland economy is also a supporting foundation for Hong Kong's development.
segments.zh: 中国作为全球经济的核心引擎，内地经济也是香港发展的重要支撑。

segments.en: Two weeks ago, Premier Li Qian, speech at the summit, that the stability of China's development is depending on two factors, first, the stable environment, second, the new channels.
segments.zh: 两周前，李强总理在峰会上指出，中国发展的稳定取决于两个因素：一是稳定环境，二是新渠道。

segments.en: Technology innovation is the long-term strategy for China's development. China has the huge market and the complete value chain and high-speed development of technology and the large pool of talents.
segments.zh: 科技创新是中国发展的长期战略。中国拥有巨大市场、完整价值链、高速发展的科技和庞大人才库。
